People in WY deserve clear answers on how COVID-era policies will continue to impact their healthcare. I joined @SenJohnBarrasso in sending a letter to the Dept. Health and Human Services asking they provide Congress with that info. Read the letter ⬇️ 
https://t.co/faURqZBW0E

Legislation I cosponsored, alongside @SenTuberville, to increase military service members’ life insurance benefit coverage was signed into law this week. This bill truly honors those who paid the ultimate sacrifice to defend our freedom.

https://t.co/4kxD4gwmHc

People from across the country are flocking West in the post-COVID era. That brings challenges including transportation, healthcare, and broadband access. The @SenWestCaucus will prioritize rural economic development and ensure the west continues to be the best place to live!

President Biden's plan to give DACA recipients Medicaid is completely insane.

Wyoming taxpayers should absolutely not be funding health care for illegal immigrants.

I’m encouraged to see @USTreasury finally issue its rules regarding tax reporting requirements for crypto brokers…however, I have serious concerns about the rule’s potential impact on decentralized crypto asset exchanges & its treatment of U.S. dollar-backed stablecoins. MORE⬇️ https://t.co/6x5VeNnaJz

It is no longer a question of whether we help Ukraine, but how we pay for it. 

The U.S. is in debt with no reforms in sight. 

Congress must make all spending discretionary, except social security, medicare and interest.

Fauci admits he and Democrats 'sort of just' made up the 'science' used to justify closing businesses, keeping kids out school and preventing people from visiting dying loved ones in hospitals.

Absolutely inexcusable.

Proud to introduce the Protect Innocent Victims of Taxation After Fire Act with @SenAlexPadilla to exempt wildfire insurance payouts from federal taxes.

When a family loses everything the last thing they should be worried about is setting aside money from insurance to pay taxes.

Thank you @SecVetAffairs, for visiting WY. 

Glad you were able to visit the University of Wyoming for a student veteran roundtable and meeting with some of the tremendous staff that serve WY veterans at the Cheyenne VA Medical Center and other VA facilities throughout the state. https://t.co/4kKdJftOie
Thank you, @halleberry for stopping by my office to discuss the importance of health care and medical research. https://t.co/ElsbP4D0HB

There are people throughout Wyoming and across this country who can barely make ends meet because of inflation and the disaster that is Bidenomics.

President Biden will now require them to pay for illegal aliens' health care. 

This is going to make the border crisis even worse.

President Biden is trying to surrender U.S. sovereignty to elite globalists at the World Health Organization.

Any agreement the U.S. attempts to make will be viewed as a treaty and needs to be sent to the Senate where I can promise you it will suffer a swift defeat. https://t.co/lGPtnC1sym

Folks across Wyoming rely on timely mail delivery for medicine, to pay bills and to communicate.

I am encouraged @USPS listened to the people of Wyoming’s concerns and halted its disastrous plans to recategorize the Cheyenne and Casper Processing and Distribution Centers.

From the billions being given to NGOs to facilitate human trafficking in Central America to offering health care for illegals, how much taxpayer money has President Biden wasted to fulfill his open border agenda?

It is very simple - when you give consumers more options costs go down and quality goes up.

That is a core tenant of economics and the reason why we need a Personal Option in health care as costs are at an all-time high.

Two years ago, the SCOTUS’ Dobbs v Jackson Women’s Health Organization took an important step in protecting the right to life for millions of Americans & returning power back to the states. Today we applaud their courage & reaffirm our commitment to upholding this sacred right.

Kamalanomics is crushing the people of Wyoming:
▪️Car insurance is UP 56.5%
▪️Gas is UP 38.4%
▪️Groceries are UP 22.1%
▪️Baby food and formula are UP 31%
▪️Real avg. weekly earnings are DOWN 3.4%.
The numbers don’t lie. We can't afford 4 more years of Democrats’ runaway spending.

I enjoyed meeting with Paul Atkins, the @SECGov Chair nominee. We discussed digital asset legislation & reforming the rulemaking process. Thanks for stopping by, and I look forward to putting the SEC on the “Atkins diet!” https://t.co/WBUAxnOMNl

The Biden admin delivers blow after blow, caring more about how his political legacy will look on paper, rather than the real burden he’s placing on Americans. The CFPB’s final rule on medical debt does nothing to solve the underlying problem. America is counting down to Jan. 20

Biden failed in his plan to “cancel” student debt. For his next magic trick, he’s going to make medical debt disappear by ordering banks to pretend it doesn’t exist. This eleventh-hour plan makes hospital visits cost more for us all. Enough is enough.

Wyoming is home to thousands of veterans, and I am proud to say SageWest Health Care became the first Purple Heart Hospital in the Cowboy State.
https://t.co/B7FokVTpBH

As HHS Secretary, RFK Jr. has committed to prioritizing rural hospitals and providing improved healthcare services to all Americans. I look forward to voting for him and helping Make America Healthy Again!

A well-deserved honor for the University of Wyoming!

https://t.co/1rbu9AmPKO

As we wait for more information on today’s crash in Green River, please join me in praying for those involved. Thank you to our first responders and medical personnel for working quickly to save lives.

https://t.co/2aYaZMWzNo

It was a joy to visit the patients & staff at Walter Reed! The patients' resiliency & the staff’s dedication are inspiring. I look forward to ensuring Walter Reed has the best resources available to serve those who have sacrificed to protect our freedoms.
